# SpacePilot

> You decide what to run. SpacePilot decides how and where.

SpacePilot is a provenance-first decision layer and inference orchestration CLI for single-owner AI compute fleets. It evaluates what models fit the hardware in front of you before you download them, pricing cold starts and warm memory residency across Apple Silicon, Linux, and Cloud instances.

## Installation

```bash
# Global CLI installation (recommended)
uv tool install spacepilot

# Or via pip
pip install spacepilot
```

## Core CLI Commands

- `spacepilot probe`: Inspect local hardware, memory hierarchy, backend (Metal/CPU/CUDA), and usable VRAM.
- `spacepilot doctor`: Check local environment, runtimes, ffmpeg, and weights.
- `spacepilot models list`: List all models with empirical fit verdicts (`runs_well`, `tight_fit`, `too_large`).
- `spacepilot runtimes list`: List available inference runtimes (Splash, MLX, Whisper.cpp, Kokoro, Edge0).
- `spacepilot-mcp`: Stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI coding agents.

## FastMCP Server Integration

Add to your MCP configuration (`~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json` or Claude Desktop):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "spacepilot": {
      "command": "spacepilot-mcp"
    }
  }
}
```
